plan.summary: BRO-5645: owner Option A (2026-10-18). Seven researched closures with no recoupment reported and no estimate become Did Not Recoup (Liberation, Oedipus, Spamalot, Sunset Boulevard 2017, Jerusalem 2011, Job, The Hills of California). The Music Man (2022) and John Proctor Is the Villain stay Undisclosed until a source settles them.
steps: Each edit reads its oldValue from live commercial.json.
